[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Energy ball recipe includes:

- 1 cup creamy peanut butter  
- 1/2 cup honey  
- 1/2 cup chocolate chips  
- Pinch of salt  
- Optional: chopped nuts, shredded coconut, or cinnamon
